ingredientSections.heading: Brussels Sprouts and Leeks
items: 900g Brussels Sprouts, washed and halved lengthways
3 Leeks, white parts only, washed and cut into 1 inch rounds

ingredientSections.heading: Beet Dyed Apple
items: 1 Granny Smith Apple, peeled, diced finely

methodSections.heading: Sweet Onion Puree
steps: In a large pan heat the olive oil to a medium heat and add the onions, salt and pepper and cook until deeply caramelized.
Smoke the onion with the applewood chips. See over page for details.
Once smoked, blend the onion until smooth. Add the maple syrup and continue to blend until fully incorporated into a puree. Set aside.

methodSections.heading: Brussels Sprouts and Leeks
steps: In a large heavy bottomed pan bring half of the oil to a medium/high heat.
Place brussels sprouts cut side down into the pan and cook until the edges of the sprouts are dark brown.
Add ¼ cup of water and cover with a lid, cook for 2-3 more minutes.
Remove the brussels sprouts and set aside.
Using the same pan, heat the remaining oil back up to a medium/high heat.
Add leek rounds and cook both sides until the edges are dark brown. Add ¼ cup of water and cover with a lid. Continue cooking for 2 minutes then remove from pan and set aside.

methodSections.heading: Beet Dyed Apple
steps: Combine both ingredients in an airtight container and shake vigorously until the diced apple is well coated. Store in the fridge until ready to use.

methodSections.heading: Mustard Seed Oil
steps: Warm the olive oil to a low heat and add the mustard seeds. Leave on the heat for 15 minutes then pour into a heat proof container. Let sit overnight in the fridge.

methodSections.heading: Assembly
steps: If you are hosting a dinner party all of the above steps can be done before hand. To reheat the brussels sprouts and leeks heat in the oven at 200°C (400°F) and warm through, about 8-10 minutes.
With a small offset spatula, scoop 1 tablespoon of the onion puree onto the left side of a small plate and smear it across to the right side.
Place brussels sprouts and leeks on top of the onion puree, sprinkle with a small spoonful of the beet dyed apple and chopped chestnuts.
Drizzle ½ tablespoon of the mustard seed oil over top and garnish with some fennel frond.
